title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics, parity fixes, v1.106.0
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: We maintain three language SDKs (Python/TypeScript/Go) and over time auth/retry ergonomics and streaming behavior have drifted. This PR unifies the auth middleware surface, standardizes retry/backoff semantics, improves streaming ergonomics (backpressure and chunked delivery), and applies parity fixes and version bumps to v1.106.0 across all SDKs. Scope: - unify auth token refresh + header injection middleware across SDKs; - introduce a shared retries policy (max attempts, idempotency awareness, jittered exponential backoff) surfaced in each SDK; - address streaming ergonomics: make stream consumers easier to await/iterate (Python async iterator + sync iterator helpers, TS ReadableStream/backpressure fix, Go Scanner-style iterator); - parity fixes: align error shapes, structured response typing, and default timeouts; - bump package versions and changelogs to v1.106.0. Checklist: - [x] unify auth middleware implementation and tests - [x] implement shared retries policy and expose configuration - [x] fix streaming consumption ergonomics in Python/TS/Go - [x] add unit & integration tests for retry behavior - [x] update changelogs and release notes - [x] run cross-SDK examples and smoke tests Implementation notes: All SDK changes are implemented behind backward-compatible flags where possible; default behavior preserves previous semantics except for streaming ergonomics which fixes a known backpressure bug (see ENG-2845). The PR touches the monorepo SDK packages (sdk/python, sdk/typescript, sdk/go) and supporting CI/test fixtures. See commits summary for details. Related: Linear ENG-2845, ENG-2901; support ticket SUP-4321 (customer streaming edge case).
commits: squash: sdk(common): introduce unified auth middleware and shared retry-policy (ENG-2845)
fix(python): streaming iterator: yield chunks and expose sync helpers + tests
fix(ts): restore ReadableStream backpressure on chunked responses; add examples
fix(go): add streaming Scanner-style iterator and align error types
chore: bump sdk versions to v1.106.0 and update changelogs

Lin Sun (review): Comment — Python iterator looks good; please add a short example showing sync consumption for Flask/WSGI users.
Asha Patel (author): Reply — added examples/examples/streams/python/README.md and updated docs/sdk-retries.md.
Priya Kapoor (review): Approved — verified TS change fixes the backpressure regression reported in SUP-4321; CI passed locally for me.
ci_checks: integration: streaming-smoke — failed on first run (flake), reran — passed
release_notes: SDKs: unified auth middleware and shared retry policy; improved streaming ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go (fixes backpressure and provides simpler iterators/helpers); several parity fixes to error shapes and typings; version bumps to v1.106.0 for all SDKs. Migration: consumers should not need to change existing code; see docs/sdk-auth.md and docs/sdk-retries.md for opt-in retry customization and idempotency hints.
